title: Rheum palmatum tea for medicinal use
intro: Rheum palmatum tea is a traditional herbal preparation made from the leaves of the rhubarb plant, known for its strong, bitter taste and medicinal properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to support digestive health and promote bowel movements due to its mild laxative effects. The tea is often prepared by steeping the dried leaves in hot water and consumed in small quantities. In traditional Chinese medicine, it is valued for its ability to clear heat and detoxify the body. It is typically used under the guidance of a qualified herbalist to ensure safe and effective use.
